bc0570ada4139628d9ed0a72585bf067f5408abb.summary: The report says cosmetics maker Estée Lauder confirmed a cyberattack in which hackers gained unauthorized access, shut some systems, and stole some data. Ransomware groups Clop and ALPHV (also known as BlackCat) listed the company as a victim. BlackCat claims to have stolen more than 130 GB without encrypting the network. Clop may have exploited vulnerabilities in MOVEit file transfer software. The nature and scope of the attack were yet to be determined.
